# TheNexTools

TheNexTools is a suite of high-performance, local-first web utilities and professional data recovery software. All web-based tools process files completely on the user's device without uploading data to servers.

## Core Products

* [NexData Recovery](/data-recovery): Professional desktop app for macOS and Windows. Recovers deleted files, lost partitions, and files from formatted or corrupted storage devices. Runs 100% offline.
* [NexPDF Toolkit](/pdf-toolkit): Browser-based workspace containing 17 utilities to merge, split, compress, sign, and convert PDF files.
* [NexImage Toolkit](/image-toolkit): Localized image processing dashboard for compression, format conversion, and EXIF metadata extraction.

## NexPDF Toolkit Utilities
All PDF utilities operate locally in the browser tab.

* [Merge PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents with drag-and-drop page reordering.
* [Split PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/split-pdf): Extract specific pages or page ranges from a PDF.
* [Compress PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/compress-pdf): Shrink PDF files locally via adjustable resolution/quality controls.
* [Sign PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/sign-pdf): Draw or type cursive signatures and stamp/flatten them onto any page.
* [Watermark PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/watermark-pdf): Add text watermarks (e.g. "CONFIDENTIAL") with control over opacity, diagonal placement, and page ranges.
* [Redact PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/redact-pdf): Permanently black out sensitive areas. Deletes text records from underlying file structure.
* [PDF to Images](/pdf-toolkit/tools/pdf-to-images): Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPEG or PNG files.
* [Scan to PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/scan-to-pdf): Use device camera to capture document pages and compile them.
* [Protect PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/protect-pdf): Add open and permissions passwords using local AES encryption.
* [Unlock PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove passwords and print/edit blocks from documents.
* [OCR PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/ocr-pdf): Extract copyable text from scanned PDFs locally using Tesseract.js.
* [HTML to PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/html-to-pdf): Input styled HTML code and generate a formatted PDF.
* [Images to PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/images-to-pdf): Package JPG, PNG, or WebP images into a single PDF.
* [Rotate PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate individual or all pages inside a PDF document.
* [Rearrange PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/rearrange-pdf): Reorganize, reorder, or delete individual pages.
* [Add Page Numbers](/pdf-toolkit/tools/add-page-numbers): Format and stamp sequential page numbering.
* [Text to PDF](/pdf-toolkit/tools/text-to-pdf): Render plain text files into clean, readable PDF documents.

## NexImage & Metadata Utilities
Batch process images locally in the browser.

* [Image Compressor](/image-compressor): Shrink JPEG, PNG, and WebP images with real-time compression level previews.
* [Image Converter](/image-converter): Convert format types between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, and BMP.
* [Image Redactor](/image-redactor): Highlight and blur faces or sensitive parts on images.
* [EXIF Stripper](/exif-stripper): Strip location coords, camera tags, and metadata details from images.
